description: ai-agents.md §21.6 pi-01 — the §21.3 integrity law: at the end of EVERY request each step is terminal (done/failed/refused) or waiting (awaiting_approval/awaiting_run), never 'active', never vanished. A mocked mid-step provider crash (500 → §20.5 retry → 500 → typed error) leaves an 'active' step behind; the orchestrator's sweep fails it with note 'interrupted: <cause>' and recomputes the plan status.
